purpose: A reviewed translation of the first Lyra candidate into discovered VARCO Flow node types. Placeholders must be replaced from real tool results; this file is not a raw MCP request.
preconditions: An authenticated official MCP client has discovered these exact tool and node schemas.
The user has approved this reference image's upload to VARCO and one generation within the point limit.
An empty target Flow has been selected from actual list_flow_sessions/get_flow_graph results.
Current account eligibility, point estimate and generated-asset license are confirmed before running.

upload.data_source: base64 of the exact local reference file, never an authentication token
upload.result_url_note: The actual result is kept only in temporary local client output, not this public file.

nodes.label: lyra_candidate
nodes.license: Resolve the actual account/node license before execution; do not silently publish to Community or impose a public license.
nodes.model: Use the real node's remembered/recommended option; no invented model identifier.

after_run: Poll get_flow_graph status; Generate3D may take 4 to 10 minutes or longer without being a failure.
Download into gitignored build/art-candidates/lyra_body and inspect with tools/inspect_glb.py.
Record selected license, permanent source task identity, input hash and local output hash; exclude signed download URLs.
Review geometry/materials before adding Rig or Animate. Do not overwrite the current runtime hero model.
